detached_structure.evidence: A separate brown-roofed building sits at the northeast end of the outlined lot, apart from the main house with the yellow dot, though it may be an attached wing.

signals.notes: The narrow lot is heavily shaded by mature trees, and the older dark-shingled house roofs are partly obscured by canopy; the pool in the top right belongs to a neighbor, and the blue tarp-like items just outside the west edge are not on this lot.
